text:
maria: quick thread to finalize one-liner decisions for Dedicated capacity roadmap doc. we need crisp defaults so eng can prototype: SKU names, default burst window lengths, carryover stance, and safe autoscale cooldown. aiming to lock these today.

ajay: propose SKU names: starter (1 GPU-eq), team (4 GPU-eq), enterprise (32 GPU-eq). tie each to a default SLO band.

ben: infra reality check: large-model coldstarts 2-4m; KV-drain ~30s. we should default scale_down_cooldown=180s and recommend scale_up smoothing 45s.

tal: UX asks: surface "remaining USD-minutes" + an explainer. carryover must be opt-in; show term during purchase.

sophia: finance/legal: prefer billing in USD-minutes. carryover = enterprise-only opt-in + audit trail. refunds only per contract.

kai: support note: soft-quota (throttle + 429 with guidance) reduces tickets. also provide fallback to smaller model variant when quota reached.

maria: burst window suggestion: starter=10m, team=30m, enterprise=24h (enterprise may opt into monthly carryover).

ajay: agree. also add a short pilot: enable carryover for 3 enterprise customers behind flag to validate billing flow.

ben: minimal example config we can ship behind flag:
```
sku_defaults:
  starter: {min_replicas:1, max_replicas:2, burst_window:10m}
  team: {min_replicas:1, max_replicas:8, burst_window:30m}
  enterprise: {min_replicas:4, max_replicas:64, burst_window:24h, carryover_opt_in:true}
autoscale:
  scale_up_window:45s
  scale_down_cooldown:180s
  preempt_policy: opportunistic-first
  soft_quota_default: true
```

tal: Console flows: buy burst -> choose window or enable carryover (enterprise) -> confirm. ledger downloadable CSV. I'll mock the flow.

sophia: legal to provide opt-in wording; finance confirms USD-minutes canonical.

kai: add telemetry: quota_rejected_reason + fallback_used metric. helps SRE.

maria: decision summary for roadmap doc: 1) SKUs = starter/team/enterprise 2) tiered burst windows (10m/30m/24h) 3) carryover = opt-in enterprise only (pilot first) 4) soft-quota default w/ hard-enforce via contract 5) cooldown=180s 6) billing unit = USD-minutes.

ops-bot: calendar event created: Dedicated Roadmap Lock  Thu 16:00. Invite sent.

maria: action items: Ben -> prototype config + feature-flag plan by Mon EOD; Ajay -> pricing bands + SLO targets; Tal -> console mock Tue; Sophia -> opt-in language Tue; Kai -> support playbook draft Wed. any objections?

ajay: none from me.

maria: ok locking these for the Q3 roadmap doc. thanks all :rocket:
